question: The parliamentary elections, Presidential and Vice Presidential elections and the office of the Election Commission come under which list of the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Union list__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 7th Schedule of the Indian Constitution

 
 
• It deals with the division of powers between the Union government and State governments.
 
• The division of powers between the Union and the State is notified through three kinds of the list mentioned in the seventh schedule:
 
 
• Union List – List I
 
• State List – List II
